purpose: Held-out seeds for Rung 3's generalization check with a real local model (ADR 0010). Chosen from a Rung 2-only survey before any model was run, and never used to change the prompt.
rule: At each level, in ascending seed order from 20, the first five seeds whose Rung 2-only run of download_report stops with an abstention Rung 3 takes up (below_threshold or below_margin), excluding every seed in heal_pairs.json and abstain_pairs.json and every seed a test uses. Seeds 0-19 are excluded: Phase 5 surveyed them and the six known Rung 2 failures come from them.
survey: uv run python -m benchmarks.chaos.rung0_seeds --level L --seeds 20-119 (level 3 extended to 120-299 because 20-119 held only two qualifying seeds)
